name: open-attendance-terminal

scripts.deneme: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n emulator,veri,uygulama "npx firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-open-attendance --config firebase.sandbox.json" "node scripts/sandbox-seed.mjs" "vite --mode sandbox --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort"
scripts.dist:win: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run smoke:package
scripts.test:unit: node --test src/card-reader.test.js src/reader-reconnect.test.js src/cards.test.js src/clock.test.js src/data.test.js src/dates.test.js src/device-config.test.js src/electron-main.test.js src/electron-serial.test.js src/export-data.test.js src/firmware-audit.test.js src/payroll.test.js src/service-worker.test.js src/ui-regressions.test.js
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-open-attendance-rules "node --test --test-concurrency=1 src/firestore-rules.test.js src/clock-rules.test.js src/offline-rules.test.js src/cards-flow.test.js src/clock-flow.test.js src/device-rest-flow.test.js"

description: Bilingual open-source attendance terminal with Electron, Firebase and ESP32 RFID hardware.
